mapper.update: INSERT INTO classification (merge_key, code_value, code_name, japanese) VALUES (#{mergeKey}, #{codeValue}, #{codeName}, #{japanese}) ON CONFLICT (merge_key) DO NOTHING

INSERT INTO patent_classification (company_id, patent_id, classification_id, inserted_at, updated_at, deleted, sync_id) SELECT c.company_id, p.patent_id, cl.classification_id, now(), now(), false, #{syncId}::uuid FROM company c JOIN patent p ON p.merge_key = #{patentMergeKey} JOIN classification cl ON cl.merge_key = #{mergeKey} WHERE c.corporate_number = #{corporateNumber} ON CONFLICT (company_id, patent_id, classification_id) DO UPDATE SET deleted = false, updated_at = now(), sync_id = EXCLUDED.sync_id WHERE patent_classification.deleted IS DISTINCT FROM false OR patent_classification.sync_id IS DISTINCT FROM EXCLUDED.sync_id

UPDATE patent_classification pc SET deleted = true, updated_at = now() FROM company c JOIN patent p ON p.merge_key = #{patentMergeKey} WHERE pc.company_id = c.company_id AND pc.patent_id = p.patent_id AND c.corporate_number = #{corporateNumber} AND pc.deleted = false

UPDATE patent_classification pc SET deleted = true, updated_at = now() FROM company c JOIN patent p ON p.merge_key = #{patentMergeKey} WHERE pc.company_id = c.company_id AND pc.patent_id = p.patent_id AND c.corporate_number = #{corporateNumber} AND pc.deleted = false AND pc.sync_id IS DISTINCT FROM #{syncId}::uuid

UPDATE patent_classification pc SET deleted = true, updated_at = now() FROM company_patent cp JOIN company c ON c.company_id = cp.company_id WHERE pc.company_id = cp.company_id AND pc.patent_id = cp.patent_id AND c.corporate_number = #{corporateNumber} AND cp.deleted = true AND pc.deleted = false
